name: LodServerSupport
version: '0.14.0'
main: dev.vox.lss.paper.LSSPaperPlugin
api-version: '1.21.1'
# 1.21.1 line: folia-supported is ABSENT — Folia never published a 1.21.1 build (its 1.21
# family starts at 1.21.4; fill.papermc.io verified 2026-08-15), so declaring the flag
# would claim support for a platform that does not exist (the pre-26.2 precedent).
# PluginYmlContractTest + release_check.py pin the ABSENCE on this line (surfaces row 7 —
# the fresh cut re-derives the direction; the Folia code paths stay in the jar, inert).
# C5 (XVER §7): the Via mismatch guard reflectively reads ViaVersion's API when the
# plugin is present. softdepend keeps Spigot's classloader from logging the one-time
# "loaded class ... which is not a depend/softdepend" warning on the first handshake —
# noise that reads like an LSS bug. No hard dependency: without Via the probe is a
# silent no-signal. LibsDisguises (issue #282): the far-player privacy ladder reads
# DisguiseAPI reflectively to hide disguised players — same precedent (load ORDER +
# classloader visibility, never a hard depend; absent = the rung is skipped).
softdepend: [ViaVersion, LibsDisguises]
description: Voxy multiplayer support (unofficial). Enables players with Voxy to see fully rendered terrain out to hundreds of chunks on multiplayer servers without needing to explore the world first.
author: VoX
website: https://modrinth.com/plugin/lod-server-support
commands:
  lsslod:
    description: LOD Server Support admin commands
    usage: /lsslod <stats|diag|store|set|help>
    permission: lss.admin
permissions:
  lss.admin:
    description: Access to LSS admin commands
    default: op
  # Far players (v0.11.0 E1): server-side privacy lever — holders are never served as
  # far players regardless of the farPlayers mode (FARP §3.2). BOTH brand spellings are
  # declared (default false) and the enforcement honors either: Bukkit resolves an
  # UNDECLARED node to the op default, so a single-brand declaration plus a cross-brand
  # check would silently hide every op — and declaring both keeps the privacy grant
  # working across an LSS<->VSS jar swap.
  lss.farplayers.hidden:
    description: Players with this permission are never shown as far players
    default: false
  vss.farplayers.hidden:
    description: Players with this permission are never shown as far players (VSS spelling)
    default: false
  # Service gate (requireServicePermission, default false): with the config key on, only
  # holders are served LOD data — a handshake from anyone else is answered with an
  # enabled=false SessionConfig and no session. BOTH brand spellings are declared for the
  # reason spelled out on lss.farplayers.hidden above (Bukkit resolves an UNDECLARED node to
  # the op default, so a single-brand declaration plus a cross-brand check goes silently
  # wrong, and declaring both keeps grants alive across an LSS<->VSS jar swap).
  #
  # `default: true`, NOT op: everyone holds these unless an admin says otherwise, so arming
  # the gate on its own changes nothing for anybody — the original behavior, preserved. The
  # gate is a DENY tool: the only thing that takes LOD away is an explicit negative grant in
  # the permission plugin (e.g. LuckPerms `group default permission set lss.use false`).

  vss.use:
    description: Receive LOD data when requireServicePermission is enabled (VSS spelling)
    default: true
